scope: All B, C, C*, D exercises after level A review; numbers refer to the pre-review ordering within each level.
method: Editorial review of all published lines and the local discovery positions, supported by legal recapture enumeration and 200,000-node Stockfish MultiPV probes of borderline examples. Probe scores are from the solver perspective and are finite-search evidence, not proof. An engine advantage alone does not establish instructional value. Earlier preparatory discoveries may be valuable, but the published payoff must demonstrate a clear causal benefit.
